result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.pagerank()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Calculate PageRank scores for all nodes in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L14160-L14299){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.pagerank( damping=0.85, max_iter=100, tol=1e-06, attr_name=None, return_dict=False ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} PageRank is a link analysis algorithm that assigns importance scores to nodes based on their incoming connections. Originally developed by Google to rank web pages, it's widely used in social network analysis, recommendation systems, and influence detection. The algorithm iteratively distributes "rank" from each node to its neighbors, with a damping factor to model random jumps. Nodes with many incoming edges from high-ranking nodes receive higher scores. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [damping]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.85]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The probability of following an edge (vs. random jump). Higher values (closer to `1.0`) give more weight to the graph structure. Typical range: `0.8`-`0.95`. [max_iter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum number of iterations to run. The algorithm stops early if convergence is reached. [tol]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1e-06]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Convergence tolerance. The algorithm stops when the sum of absolute differences between iterations is less than this value. [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Column name to store PageRank scores in the node DataFrame. If `None` (default), automatically uses `pagerank`. Overwrites column if it already exists. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, returns dictionary instead of self. If `False` (default), stores in NDF and returns self for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Union[dict[int, float], Graph]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `return_dict` is `True`: dictionary mapping node IDs to PageRank scores (sum to `1.0`). If `return_dict` is `False` (default): returns self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Calculate PageRank on a simple social network: ::: {#27e42d0a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_node(label="Charlie") ) alice_id = graph.get_id_from_label("Alice") bob_id = graph.get_id_from_label("Bob") charlie_id = graph.get_id_from_label("Charlie") graph.add_edge(alice_id, bob_id) graph.add_edge(alice_id, charlie_id) graph.add_edge(bob_id, charlie_id) scores = graph.pagerank(return_dict=True) # Returns {1: 0.262, 2: 0.262, 3: 0.475} (Node IDs to scores) scores ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {1: 0.1975796492961225, 3: 0.520869350456903, 2: 0.28155100024697455} ``` ::: ::: ::: {#d32c1937 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Convert to labels if needed label_scores = {graph.get_label_from_id(nid): score for nid, score in scores.items()} # Returns {'Alice': 0.262, 'Bob': 0.262, 'Charlie': 0.475} label_scores ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` {'Alice': 0.1975796492961225, 'Charlie': 0.520869350456903, 'Bob': 0.28155100024697455} ``` ::: ::: Use custom damping factor for more exploration: ::: {#466b1bc8 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_node(label="Charlie") ) graph.add_edge(source="Alice", target="Bob") graph.add_edge(source="Alice", target="Charlie") graph.add_edge(source="Bob", target="Charlie") scores = graph.pagerank(damping=0.5) # More random jumping ``` ::: Find the most influential nodes: ::: {#0234dde7 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_node(label="Charlie") ) graph.add_edge(source="Alice", target="Bob") graph.add_edge(source="Alice", target="Charlie") graph.add_edge(source="Bob", target="Charlie") scores = graph.pagerank(return_dict=True) top_nodes = sorted(scores.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5] #
